A 4×4 journey into the Western Desert, usually starting from Bahariya Oasis. The route crosses the Black Desert, with its dark volcanic hills, to the White Desert, where wind has carved chalk into giant white mushrooms and pillars.

A day trip from Aswan to Abu Simbel, far to the south near the Sudanese border. You’ll see the two rock-cut temples built by Ramesses II: the Great Temple, fronted by four colossal seated statues of the king, and the smaller temple dedicated to Queen Nefertari and the goddess Hathor.

A guided visit to Luxor’s West Bank, the burial ground of ancient Thebes. You’ll go down into the painted royal tombs of the Valley of the Kings, visit the terraced temple of Hatshepsut beneath the cliffs, and usually stop at the Colossi of Memnon.
